MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Monash Health exists to reimagine care, so that people can live their best lives. 







We provide safe and equitable care, for every stage of life, delivered with world-leading expertise and over 175 years of experience. 







As a leading academic health service, we're committed to providing tomorrow's care today by integrating research, teaching and training into everyday practice. 







Our team of 24,000 people are full hearted, open minded and all in. Together, we provide more than 250 integrated services for every stage of life at over 50 locations and in the community across south-east Melbourne, Victoria, serving 1.2 million residents in the South Metro Local Health Service Network. 







To see first-hand what our colleagues think about working here, take a look at the following short videos monashhealth.org-careers.




Help shape the future of healthcare at Monash Health and embark on a rewarding career where your dedication makes a difference in people's lives.



About the Role


Join our team as an Environmental Services Assistant on a part timeto work at Kingston Dialysis Unitbased in Heatherton. In this role, you will be guided under the leadership of the General Services Manager and working with the broader Support Services team.



ESAs are responsible for maintaining a clean, hygienic, and safe hospital environment; not only for patients, but also for visitors and colleagues across Monash Health. ESAs deliver high-quality environmental services across clinical and non-clinical areas.



Key responsibilities include, but not limited to:



Ensuring adherence to infection prevention and control protocols at all times


Adhering to safety protocols when using cleaning chemicals and equipment in line with safety guidelines


Managing waste removal and disposal procedures safely and responsibly


Maintaining cleaning schedules and documentation


Reporting maintenance or safety hazards promptly


Collaborating with clinical and support teams to deliver service excellence


Completing relevant workplace training modules 


Distribution and collection of linen


Physical work including lifting and manual handling




We currently have the following opportunity available: 


Kingston Dialysis Unit


Days: Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday and Saturday


Hours: 5am-10.30am


Total hours per fortnight: 40



About You



To ensure your success in this role, you will bring experience in environmental services within a hospital, Aged Care or commercial cleaning setting with strong demonstrated knowledge of infection control and hygiene practices. You are a reliable and punctual team member with great verbal and written communication skills. Whether you're work independently or as part of a team; you always follow manual handling, safety protocols, and procedural instructions.



Why you will love working with us



As an ESA, you will play a vital role in supporting patient care while working within a supportive and inclusive team culture. Monash Health offers ongoing opportunities for professional development and leadership training. ESAs benefit from job stability within Victoria's largest public health service, along with clear career pathways across environmental and support services.




As a Monash Health employee you will enjoy a variety of benefits, such as:




Salary packaging options to increase your take-home pay


 Novated leasing for vehicle options


 Full-time employees accrue 5 week's annual leave (pro rata for part-time employees) 


 Free annual flu vaccinations


Uniform and laundry allowance




About Kingston Centre:



Kingston Centre is a specialist healthcare facility in Melbourne's south-east, operated by Monash Health, that focuses on rehabilitation, aged care and ongoing recovery. It provides a wide range of services including sub-acute care, aged mental health, residential aged care and allied health, helping patients regain independence and improve their quality of life. The centre also offers specialised clinics and programs-such as dementia, falls and movement disorder services-supporting both older adults and people recovering from illness or injury.




For a confidential discussion and to explore this opportunity further, please reach out toMatthewTetley on 0439055334



Position Description can be found here






Our Culture and Values 







At Monash Health, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Our culture is inclusive, supportive and future-focused, underpinned by clear values and a commitment to continuous improvement. 







Our teams play a critical role in bringing our new strategy to life, challenging traditional approaches, embracing innovation, and ensuring every appointment reflects our commitment to equity, transparency and excellence. 







You'll be encouraged to share ideas, contribute to improvement initiatives, and grow alongside experienced professionals who are passionate about what they do. 







We are Full Hearted, Open Minded and All In, enabling excellent service delivery and a positive candidate and employee experience every time. 







We recognise the value of equal employment opportunity. We are committed to patient safety, promoting fairness, equity and diversity in the workplace and to Child Safe Standards. 





How to Apply



Applications are accepted via the Monash Health online EHub system. For information including how to apply and probity check requirements, please click here for the 'Application Guide'



Applications will be screened upon receipt and selection activity may commence prior to the closing date.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Your role at St John of God Murdoch Hospital 

Join the Catering Services team at St John of God Murdoch Hospital as a Casual Food Services Assistant! Casual positions now available!

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, take pride in delivering excellent service, and want to contribute to a positive experience for patients and visitors, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

As a Food Services Assistant, you'll play an important role in supporting the delivery of high-quality food and hospitality services throughout the hospital. You'll be involved in all stages of food preparation, assist with equipment handling and kitchen operations, and help deliver and serve meals to patients, caregivers, and visitors across various areas of the Catering Services Department.

This casual position offers flexibility, a supportive team environment, and the chance to make a meaningful difference every day by helping provide comfort, care, and nourishment to those who need it most.

The Position

Interpret menu tray cards for meal service to patients.

Assist with the preparation, plating, delivery of meals and snacks to patients and staff to various locations throughout the Hospital.

Prepare, maintain and assist with the provision of meals and snacks in the staff dining room.

Assist with the washing of cutlery, crockery and glassware.

Assist with the washing up of large heavy-duty pots, pans and other kitchen utensils.

Observe and practice all aspects of food, kitchen and personal hygiene.

Assist with general kitchen hygiene, washing of walls, floors, refrigerators etc and other areas as requested.

You will have a fundamental understanding of kitchen hygiene and experience preparing vegetables, salads, and sandwiches in large quantities. Additionally, you will be able to accurately interpret menus, communicate effectively with colleagues and customers, and perform basic cash register reconciliation and cash handling tasks.

To succeed you will have a high standard of personal presentation and punctuality with the willingness to learn new coffee and food production skills. Previous barista and cash handling experience will be beneficial to the role.

Above all people will be at the core of everything you do committing to and supporting our Mission and Values.

We can offer you

Salary: $38.49 to $39.86 per hour (inclusive of casual loading), plus 12% superannuation

A casual position

As a casual employee, you can salary package a percentage of your earnings each pay period

Employee discount on St John of God Hospital & Medical Services and Private Health Insurance

Employee support through our dedicated free Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Innovative Professional Development opportunities

All applicants are asked to submit a current CV and covering letter (of no more than two (2) pages) demonstrating how you meet the above position requirements.

For enquiries contact Debra Harrison, Executive Chef, on 08 9366 1002.

If suitable applicants are identified advertisement may close prior to listed date and screening-interviews may commence throughout the advertising process.

Hospitality Management

CH on Peel Pty Ltd is looking for another full-time member for its management team. Situated in the heart of Tamworth, our operations include the 62 room CH Boutique Hotel, the heritage listed DECO Wine Bar & Restaurant, Hopscotch Restaurant, the Pavilion Function & Conference Centre, Pig & Tinder Box Restaurant & Bar, The Bureau, and the Dungowan Brewery. All our restaurants are full service dine in establishments.

The Position

You will have an opportunity to further develop your hospitality skills and experience work in a variety of areas across our food service sites. The position includes managerial level food and beverage duties and bar work. This position is suited for candidates that like to work in a fast-paced supportive team environment, with high quality table service experience preferred. The successful applicant must be available across a 7 day roster including nights and weekends.

As a member of our management team, you will be responsible for the overall running of the business from top to bottom, leading by example and maintaining high standards. You must be highly motivated and able to manage all operational elements of the business from front to back of house. You will be passionate about your job, have a superior knowledge of food and beverage, understand the order of service and ensure our clients leave having had an all-round unforgettable dining experience.

Key Duties

* Delivering exceptional Customer Service
* Maintaining the service area
* Knowledge of Food Safety requirements
* Understanding of liquor licensing laws and compliance
* Proven record managing restaurants and meeting KPI targets
* Proven financial management capabilities
* Arranging bespoke events
* Experience in training staff with cultural sensitivity
* Working with our chefs to update and improve menus
* Overseeing of rostering
* Selecting and training restaurant and service staff
* Stock level management
* Cash handling and register operation

The Person

* RSA Certificate Essential
* Diploma in Hospitality Operations or Similar desirable
* Previous Bar experience
* Be able to work independently
* Experience in a fast-paced hospitality environment
* Great presentation and customer service skills
* Willingness to be part of an enthusiastic and motivated team
* Willingness to jump into any task required, cleaning, food preparation and customer service
* Strong awareness of Hygiene & Food Safety Standards
* Must always be well presented, have a great work ethic and the ability to perform well under pressure
* A Positive can-do attitude and the ability to work nights & weekends

So, if you are a 'can-do' person, who thrives on new challenges; likes working in a team environment; and consistently delivers to the highest quality, then you'll fit right in and we'd like to have you on our team.
